title: Somewhere and Back
subtitle: 城市生活 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 城市生活（人与社会·社会服务与人际沟通·城市生活）
meta: 主题语境：城市生活（人与社会·社会服务与人际沟通·城市生活）　|　核心词汇：somewhere　|　正文 307 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 somewhere 的位置与含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: ① Somewhere, in 1993 the porter put the bag at the cove, and everybody in the coast said it was the first time anybody had done such a thing there. Three weeks on, people still spoke of that morning: the porter had put the bag ② somewhere twice over, and nobody had asked a single question. The porter had come to the coast two weeks earlier, and spoke little of the coast he had left behind him.

The journal for August 1987 puts it plainer. The bag was ③ somewhere, and the visitor who kept it wrote of the bag ④ somewhere in the same line; nothing in the coast was ever left somewhere for long in those days. The visitor wrote that line himself and read it aloud once every week thereafter.

My uncle, who kept the bag at the far cove, meant something else. He had come from ⑤ somewhere, and ⑥ Somewhere came the visitor who was to carry it back; he was not a man who explained himself, and the coast had long since stopped asking him to.

By 2000 the matter had shrunk to half a line in the journal. What the line asked for was that the bag be bought ⑦ somewhere at the cove, and that everybody be ⑧ somewhere before the August rains. Everybody laughed at the wording, and then did exactly what it said, as they always did; everybody there knew the work had been carried somewhere.

My mother said nothing at all. In 2003 she put the bag ⑨ somewhere year after year when nobody else would, and ⑩ Somewhere, she said in 2005, that was the part the coast never forgot; the journal still speaks of it somewhere. She kept the bag in the same cove for thirty years afterwards, and never once said why; the coast never forgot how somewhere it had all been done.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请为文中十处画线形式选择对应的用法说明。
options: A. adv. 在某处（句末状语，置于宾语之后：put the bag somewhere，文中第 2、9 题两处）
B. adv. 在某处（作表语，说明处所或去向：the bag was somewhere）
C. adv. 到某处（置于句首：Somewhere, …，文中第 1、10 题两处）
D. adv. 到某处（作后置定语，紧跟被修饰的名词：the bag somewhere）
E. adv. 到某处（作介词宾语：from somewhere）
F. adv. 到某处（句首强调，引起全部倒装：Somewhere came the visitor）
G. adv. 在某处（被动结构中置于过去分词之后：be bought somewhere at the cove）
H. adv. 在某处（be somewhere 说明所在或去向：everybody be somewhere before the rains）

answers.why: somewhere 意为“到某处”，此处置于句首交代地点或去向：Somewhere, in 1993 …。
somewhere 意为“在某处”，此处置于宾语之后作状语：had put the bag somewhere。
somewhere 意为“在某处”，此处作表语说明那件小小的行囊的去向或所在：was somewhere。
somewhere 意为“到某处”，此处作后置定语紧跟名词：the bag somewhere。
somewhere 意为“到某处”，此处作介词 from 的宾语：from somewhere。
somewhere 意为“到某处”，此处置于句首引起全部倒装：Somewhere came the visitor。
somewhere 意为“在某处”，被动结构中副词置于过去分词之后：be bought somewhere at the cove。
somewhere 意为“在某处”，be somewhere 说明众人须在雨季前到达某处或处于某状态。
somewhere 意为“在某处”，2003 年母亲在无人肯做时又一次放置那件小小的行囊，副词置于句末。
somewhere 意为“到某处”，母亲 2005 年那句话以地点状语开头：Somewhere, …。

task2.title: Task 2　语境运用
task2.intro: 请把下列句子译成英文，括号里是必须用到的形式。
items: 1993 年，挑夫在小湾放置那件小小的行囊；海岸里人人都说那是头一回。（Somewhere, …）
挑夫已经把那件小小的行囊放置在某处。（… somewhere …）
那件小小的行囊当时就在在某处。（was somewhere）
行记那一行写的是在某处的那件小小的行囊。（the bag somewhere）
叔叔是从在某处回来的。（from somewhere）
记录要求那件小小的行囊在小湾被买在某处。（be bought somewhere）
answers: Somewhere, in 1993 the porter put the bag at the cove.
The porter had put the bag somewhere twice over.
The bag was somewhere, or so the journal says.
The journal spoke of the bag somewhere.
The journal asked that the bag be bought somewhere at the cove.

task3.title: Task 3　语境写作
task3.intro: 请写 5—6 个句子，至少使用 somewhere 的 3 种不同位置（句首、句末、表语、后置定语、介词宾语等）；至少使用下列词语中的 3 个。
answers: Somewhere, in 1993 the porter put the bag, and nobody forgot it.
The porter had put the bag somewhere twice over.
The bag was somewhere, or so the journal says.
The visitor wrote of the bag somewhere in the same line.
My mother put the bag somewhere year after year when nobody else would.
Somewhere, the coast never forgot that part of the story.
